topics.topic: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell Investigation
topics.description: The investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell is trending due to the high-profile nature of the case and the potential implications for the US economy. Lawmakers and former Fed leaders have denounced the inquiry, sparking concerns about the motivations behind the investigation.
